info.title: RecursiveExtractor.Cli
info.description: RecursiveExtractor is able to process the following formats: ar, bzip2, deb, gzip, iso, tar, vhd, vhdx, vmdk, wim, xzip, and zip. RecursiveExtractor automatically detects the archive type and fails gracefully when attempting to process malformed content.

options.name: --input
options.description: The name of the archive to extract.

options.name: --allow-globs
options.description: Comma-separated list of glob expressions. When set, files are ONLY written to disk if they match one of these filters.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Set logging to 'debug'.

options.name: --deny-globs
options.description: Comma-separated list of glob expressions. When set, files are NOT written to disk if they match one of these filters.

options.name: --no-recursion
options.description: Disable recursive extraction.

options.name: --output
options.description: The directory to extract to.

options.name: --passwords
options.description: Comma-separated list of passwords to use.

options.name: --print-names
options.description: Output the names of all files extracted.

options.name: --raw-extensions
options.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to treat as raw files (don't recurse into).

options.name: --single-thread
options.description: Disable parallelized extraction.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Set logging to 'verbose'.
